name: Hôtel de Ville de Grenoble
elevationDatum: Rigid local exterior foundation plane y=0; metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once. No sea-level, DEM or Mercator scaling.
note: Novarina’s modernist civic complex: broad concrete courtyard podium, glazed office blade and deep cantilevered roof cap. Published descriptions disagree between about 40 m for the tower volume and 46.5 m overall; 46.5 m is adopted as the OSM estimated total, not a survey. Podium two-level height 9.5 m follows the exterior photos rather than the ambiguous aggregate five-level OSM tag; glazing and roof overhangs are photo-calibrated approximations.
